passage.label: Al-Baqarah — address to Children of Israel: remember favor, fulfill covenant

arabicExcerpts.text: يَٰبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَـٰٓءِيلَ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتِيَ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَنۡعَمۡتُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَأَوۡفُواْ بِعَهۡدِيٓ أُوفِ بِعَهۡدِكُمۡ وَإِيَّـٰيَ فَٱرۡهَبُونِ

mainSubject.label: Direct address to Bani Israel: remember Allah's favor, fulfill His covenant so He fulfills theirs, and fear only Him

subordinateSubjects.label: Address to Children of Israel (Ya Bani Israel)
Command to remember Allah's bestowed favor (ni'mati)
Mutual covenant: fulfill Mine and I fulfill yours
Exclusive awe/fear directed to Allah alone (iyyaya farhaboon)

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Obligation of gratitude through remembrance of divine favors
Covenantal reciprocity as framework for divine-human relationship

relationships.label: Covenantal bond between Allah and Bani Israel

notes: Pass A pilot 3, passage 7/4. Single verse transitioning to Bani Israel discourse. First occurrence of Ya Bani Israel in Al-Baqarah.
